description:
Implement [the test result caching spec](https://github.com/firefly-engineering/turnkey/blob/5c64cfb91815/docs/specs/test-result-caching.md) (mechanism: [ADR 0001](https://github.com/firefly-engineering/turnkey/blob/5c64cfb91815/docs/adr/0001-runner-recorded-native-test-caching.md)). `tk test` reuses a recorded result for any test whose result key is unchanged: across daemon restarts, `buck2 clean` and checkouts, on darwin and Linux. It must be able to switch to a remote REAPI endpoint without a redesign.

Children are tracer-bullet slices. Language rollout priority: Rust, Jsonnet, Go, Python, Solidity. That order is a priority, not a dependency.
title: Implement test result caching
